lines.t: Pав , breathing murder
Fistful of letters
Dragging all the saints in the chains and fetters Thought he served the God of Abraham's line
I'm stabbing at the heart of the true vine On the road, though, screaming in the midday sun
Raging his chest like a loaded gun I'll crush this way, I'll erase his name
Not knowing no one he hunted bore his shame Blast a light like sunrise crown
Voice like thunder, knocks him down Why persecute me, tearin' his bones
Every stone he thrown hit the cornerstone Three days blind in a black glass sky
Every breath of weight, every memory cries You killed Yahshua with the hate in your veins
Now you're locked in the dark with his blood on your hands
No food, no drink in the city night No log, no bows, just the end of his might
The hunter chained to an unseen wall Every shout in his mind, now a funeral call
His horror burns like fire in his chest Every scroll he masterizes to protest
The lamb in the Passover's bleeding door The servant he rejected on the temple floor
I was clean, I was pure, I was zealous and right
Now I see, I was swinging at the Lord of light
I was sure, I could see, I could judge, I could stand
Now I'm drowning in the blood on my own hands, yeah
Face like a pounding, fracturing heart
Every kick, drum, tears, this world apart
High hats hiss like a serpent's lie
Smashed bench space as the old man dies
Footsteps echo on a straight street stone Hands laid gentle on a man undone
Brother, receive your sight, it's set Spells crash down as the dark man's dead
Color floods in like a covenant flood World washed clean in Messiah's blood
Faces he hunted now blazing bright Brothers and sisters in the risen light
Three days blind, now the world ignites Every ancient line turns to living light
You thought you'd ended in buried in fame But he rose in power and he called your name
Three days dead in the tomb of your will Now the ruler breathes and your heart stands still
Eyes resurrected, vision set free See every prophecy aiming straight to He
Now the baseline marches like a holy drum
Orders from the king to the nations
Run from dragon's breath to the spirit's sword
From blind accuser to a seer of the Lord
Thank you.
